definition: At every Nat station n, if the immediate upstream output signal(n+1) is none, issued(n) holds. This is only the positive trigger direction. Its converse is not an independent assumption.
note: Source-free closed-channel response interface. Option Nat admits only no code or a finite indexed code. Applying none to absence of a physical particle or message requires exhaustive code/detector and no-interference warrant; arbitrary malformed or limit-position inputs are not excluded by the mathematics. PGR's create-on-absence clause motivates a candidate reading, not an attributed exact statement or established physical law.
